rationale: The assistant correctly identified the hidden truth (normal cooling-fan run-on on a combi microwave) in a single turn, hedged with 'probably', used the customer's door-open and old-model details accurately and invented nothing. It gave a useful self-check ('If the noise stops on its own within about 10 minutes, there is nothing to worry about') rather than asking the expected questions about duration and cold running, but did not say what to do if the fan runs constantly or when cold (contact Samsung under warranty), leaving the escalation path implicit. No parts, no safety issues, no looping; a UK homeowner would be reassured and well served, with only a minor gap in covering the fault case.
